title: Content-twin reuse leaves completed budget-paused tasks falsely pending
summary: A budget-paused embedding task remains eligible for content-addressed reuse, so a byte-distinct content twin can materialize the same current-profile vector and rebuild `chunk_vec` for the paused chunk. Reconciliation then sees the chunk as live and already embedded, but a reason-blind `TaskStatus::Paused` guard preserves `Paused(budget_exceeded)` instead of marking the task `Done`. `index_status` continues to report pending enrichment and `budget_paused=true` even though the searchable vector exists.

affectedLocations.label: held_only_filter
affectedLocations.detail: Only `secrets_tier_b_hold` chunks are excluded from content-vector rebuild.

affectedLocations.label: content_reuse_projection
affectedLocations.detail: Rebuild joins chunks to embeddings by `text_hash` and links every non-held chunk into `chunk_vec`.

affectedLocations.label: completion_detection
affectedLocations.detail: A live chunk with a current content vector and `chunk_vec` row is no longer pending.

affectedLocations.label: root_control
affectedLocations.detail: The `Paused` guard skips `embedding_done_transition()` for all pause reasons.

affectedLocations.label: status_sink
affectedLocations.detail: The stale budget task remains pending and sets `budget_paused`.

codeEvidence.label: Only secrets holds are excluded from rebuild
codeEvidence.explanation: The exclusion set is intentionally reason-specific. A `Paused(budget_exceeded)` task is not a secrets hold, so its chunk is allowed to receive a content-twin projection.

codeEvidence.label: Rebuild links chunks by shared text hash
codeEvidence.explanation: The projection joins live chunks to content embeddings by `text_hash`. Because budget-paused chunks are not in `held_chunk_ids`, a byte-distinct twin that shares normalized text can make the paused chunk searchable.

codeEvidence.label: Current vector plus projection removes the chunk from pending work
codeEvidence.explanation: `live_chunks_without_embedding` skips a chunk once the content vector and `chunk_vec` row exist. The budget-paused chunk is therefore no longer treated as material embedding work.

codeEvidence.label: Reconciliation names the already-complete state
codeEvidence.code:
let live = live_ids.contains(chunk_id);
let live_embedded = live && !pending_ids.contains(chunk_id);
codeEvidence.explanation: A live chunk absent from `pending_ids` is already embedded. This is the state that should allow a budget-paused task to converge without another adapter call.

codeEvidence.label: All paused tasks skip the done transition
codeEvidence.explanation: After the code proves the chunk is live and not pending, it still skips completion for every `Paused` task. That preserves a completed `budget_exceeded` pause as if it were an unsent secrets hold.

codeEvidence.label: Stale budget pause drives automation-facing status
codeEvidence.explanation: The preserved task row is counted as pending enrichment and sets `budget_paused`, even though content-twin reuse has already supplied the vector.

rootCause.summary: The violated invariant is that pause reasons carry different security meanings after a live chunk is already embedded. The rebuild path is reason-specific and excludes only `secrets_tier_b_hold`, so `Paused(budget_exceeded)` chunks can correctly reuse a content-twin vector. The reconciliation path then discards that reason and treats every `Paused` task as sticky, skipping the `Done` transition that would clear a completed budget pause.

validation.method: static source trace plus local offline state-model PoC; supplied validation report records a hermetic CLI reproduction with mock embeddings
validation.summary: The source trace confirms that only secrets holds are excluded from content-hash rebuild, the pending detector treats a chunk with a current vector and projection as complete, and the later `Paused` guard refuses to mark a completed budget pause `Done`. The included PoC asserts the vulnerable false-pending state and the reason-specific fixed behavior with synthetic data.
assertions: A budget-paused chunk is eligible for content-twin `chunk_vec` rebuild because only `secrets_tier_b_hold` chunks enter `held_chunk_ids`.
Once the shared vector exists, the chunk is no longer pending material embedding work.
The final sweep skips all `TaskStatus::Paused` rows, preserving `Paused(budget_exceeded)` after work is complete.
`compute_index_status` maps that stale row to pending enrichment and `budget_paused=true`.
limitations: This TAC attempt did not rerun the full CLI lifecycle or call an embedding adapter.
No downstream automation was shown taking a harmful action based on the false status.

attackPath.summary: A local content contributor supplies two byte-distinct documents that normalize to identical chunk text. One chunk is first paused by a hard budget cap. After the operator makes budget available, the twin obtains the shared embedding, rebuild links both chunks by `text_hash`, and reconciliation leaves the original task budget-paused because the paused guard is reason-blind.

dataflow.summary: content twin text -> shared `text_hash` embedding -> `rebuild_chunk_vec` projection -> live embedded reconciliation state -> skipped `Done` transition -> false `index_status` budget pause
dataflow.source: contributor-controlled local scope content and ordering
dataflow.outcome: automation-facing status reports an actionable budget pause after the vector is already searchable

reachability.summary: The path requires an embedding profile, a genuine hard budget pause, a byte-distinct normalized-content twin, later budget availability, and ordinary re-indexing.
reachability.entrypoint: repository or scope content indexed by KCS
reachability.outcome: persistent false pending and budget-paused task state

impact.why: The stale row can mislead agents, CI, or operators into treating a completed scope as budget-blocked.

likelihood.why: The transition is deterministic with the right lifecycle, but the contributor does not independently control the operator's budget cap changes.

limitations: Search data remains intact and both documents can be returned.
No confidentiality, authorization, or extra-spend bypass was demonstrated.
Explicit `batch resume --override-budget` can repair the row without another adapter attempt.

remediation.summary: Classify paused embedding tasks by `fallback_reason` once the chunk is live and already embedded. Preserve `secrets_tier_b_hold`, but allow completed `budget_exceeded` tasks to take the existing no-adapter `embedding_done_transition()` path.
remediation.minimalFix: Replace the Boolean `paused` guard with a reason-specific hold check such as `task.status == TaskStatus::Paused && task.fallback_reason.as_deref() == Some(SECRETS_TIER_B_HOLD)` before skipping completion.
regressionTests: Budget pause, byte-distinct normalized-content twin, rebuild, and re-index should converge the original task to `Done` with `pending_enrichment_tasks=0` and `budget_paused=false`.
The same shape with `secrets_tier_b_hold` should remain paused and excluded from unauthorized vector search.
The convergence path should make no adapter attempt and record no new budget reservation when the vector already exists.
